text:
olivia: Quick sync — found a gap in our on-prem packaging compatibility matrix when staging bundles for RHEL8 vs RHEL9. small stuff but will block a few customers.
raj: what gap specifically?
marta: is this a runtime libc/ldconfig problem or packaging metadata?
olivia: mostly metadata + systemd unit path differences. our seed installer assumes /lib/systemd/system for unit files, RHEL9 puts them in /usr/lib/systemd/system in some installs.
simon: oof. that explains failing smoke checks in the staging env. tests showed services not registering. short term we can add a path fallback in the operator.
raj: fallback is easiest. longer term we should bake path normalization into the packager so bundles are relocatable.
olivia: agree. also saw tarball extraction order causing partial-activation on low-disk nodes. operator started activation before full blob extraction finished.
marta: can we include an activation marker file and have the operator wait for it? that'd be simple to implement.
simon: yes — add <ACTIVATION_COMPLETE> sentinel written at end of apply pipeline. operator checks existence and checksum.
olivia: also want to discuss signed manifests. we already sign top-level manifest, but operator currently only verifies signature for full downloads, not seed-delta applies. requires small change to verifier to handle chained manifest signatures for deltas.
raj: is there an attack vector if we skip delta signature verification? customers will expect chain-of-trust across incremental updates.
marta: security wins. implement verify for delta manifolds; we can reuse the existing signer API but need a stable canonicalization step.
olivia: bringing up staging ops concerns: our staging workflow currently uses a shared NFS seed for airgapped rehearsals — that's messy for checksum idempotency. we should simulate the offline gateway using a local content-addressed cache.
simon: +1. a local content-addressed cache makes resume deterministic and will match production seed syncing better.
raj: operationally, how do we run canaries in an airgapped customer site? can't hit our hosted healthcheck endpoints.
marta: we already have operator-run canary mode: it runs a small local verification pod that emits metrics to the customer prometheus. we can extend it to run smoke prompts on model-serving components and surface pass/fail in the console when connected.
olivia: also need to reduce bundle size for limited-transfer setups. suggest split manifest into metadata + blob-index so seed transfer can prioritize small critical blobs first.
simon: that helps parallelization too. we can stream small index first so operator can plan apply order and preallocate disk.
raj: edge case: what about mixed-arch clusters (x86 + arm) in airgapped infra? packager must produce per-arch submanifests and operator should pick the right one based on node label.
marta: agreed. and we should add an explicit arch field in the manifest root to avoid heuristic matching.
olivia: last ops item: staged rollout window. ops asked for a soft hold window where operator applies but doesn't activate until a manual approve file is present. useful for high-risk clusters.
simon: add a `staged_hold: true` flag in manifest and operator CLI `operator release-approve --manifest-id <id>` to flip.
raj: can we implement automated timeout with rollback? e.g., if no approve in X hours, attempt automatic rollback to previous activation state.
marta: yes but must be safe — rollback requires previous-image retention and idempotent apply. we'll need to enforce garbage collection retention policy for one previous activation.
olivia: i'll draft an RFC for: (1) packager path normalization + arch submanifests, (2) sentinel activation file + index-first streaming, (3) chained delta signature verification, (4) staged_hold with approve CLI + timeout rollback, (5) local content-addressed staging cache for rehearsals.
simon: sounds good. can someone add a short ops checklist for rehearse vs production apply? staging folks need exact steps.
raj: i'll add a checklist block in the RFC. rough items: prepare cache, produce index-first bundle, run operator in dry-run, validate sentinel & checksums, flip staged_hold, run smoke tests, approve to activate.
marta: for implementation owners: packager -> olivia, operator changes -> simon, verifier -> raj, staging infra -> marta.
olivia: cool. tagging @deploy-bot so CI can run the packaging e2e quickly on the staging branch.
deploy-bot: CI: packaging-e2e started for branch "staging/packager-normalize" — logs: https://ci.internal/packaging-e2e/1123 :eyes:
raj: thanks. i'll wait for green then PR the verifier changes.
marta: ping me when the cache infra PR is up, i'll wire staging rehearsal.
olivia: thanks team. I'll open the RFC and link here. :thumbsup:
